environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward-only, no rule actions beyond routing). The ALB target group performs health checks on /health. Security groups allow inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to container on 8080. No additional middleware or request filtering is configured. The SQLite database file is mounted from an EFS volume with read-write permissions. CloudWatch logs capture stdout only.
